caption:
Dishes done? Your quiet Thanksgiving night can be one old red truck with a tree in the back. 🎄

My Country Christmas book has 66 scenes. Snowy barns, farmhouse wreaths, vintage trucks hauling trees. The line art is bold and open, so a beginner can finish a page, and there's still plenty of depth if you've been coloring for years.

There are 23 printable covers too. Print the pages, bind them with the cover you like best, and wrap it up as a gift.

It's US Letter 8.5 x 11 in and prints edge to edge at 100%. You'll get a print-ready PDF plus 300 dpi PNG and JPG files. Instant download.
